'''Emmanuel''' is a male NPC found at [[Startorch Academy (Region)|Startorch Academy - Freight Zone]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Emmanuel:''' "We once dreamed of reaching the stars, but that dream was shattered by the appearance and relentless expansion of the [[Etheric Sea]]..."
:'''Emmanuel:''' "However, the great discovery beneath Lahai-Roi, the very Pathway that brought the [[Exostrider]] here, might show us a way back to the cosmos we lost..."
:'''Emmanuel:''' "...And the human alliance that aims to reopen that Pathway is called the [[Spacetrek Collective]]."
:'''Emmanuel:''' I have to memorize this script... I have to memorize it!
:'''Emmanuel:''' Oh no, oh no... Why did they pick me to brief the Council?!
{{Dialogue End}}
